_comment: Robinhood Chain TESTNET twin of deploy.robinhood.json for the rehearsal (scripts/chain/robinhood-testnet-rehearsal.md). The rehearsal script deploys MockPonsEscrow + MockERC20 'MESH-test' + PonsFeeVault with a throwaway key and prints the values to paste here (or into Admin → Token). Pons itself is not on the testnet, so ponsEscrow here is OUR MockPonsEscrow.
_comment_ponsEscrow: MockPonsEscrow from the rehearsal script (stands in for the Pons Fee Escrow).
_comment_fixedEthUsd: Testnet ETH has no price; a fixed number makes the USD arithmetic visible.
_comment_excludeWallets: Add the rehearsal 'curve' wallet (the one that received the whole MESH-test supply).
